concept: AWS Config: resource configuration history and compliance
tests: Distinguishing CloudTrail from Config: a question about a resource's state over time.
expected: AWS Config — configuration timeline and compliance rule evaluation; answers "was the bucket ever public". Triggers: "ever publicly accessible", "timeline of configuration changes".
why_not: CloudTrail shows API calls, not a clean state timeline; Logs Insights queries log content; EventBridge routes events and stores no history.
